verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a distinct Data Source verification check that confirms identity information such as name, DOB, ID numbers and address against regulated data sources. It is separate from Documentary Verification, and workflows can run checks conditionally, so document scans can be reserved for step-up cases. However, the specific sources the story names are not documented: SSN, national registries and credit-header data are never named. Missing for 10: explicit SSN/national-registry/credit-header source coverage, a documented document-free data-source-only flow configuration, country coverage of data sources, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify identity against authoritative databases without documents — SSN, national registries, or credit-header data — for lower-friction flows where a doc scan is overkill

citations.quote: Confirm identity information against regulated data sources in seconds.
you can verify identification documents, phone numbers, name, date of birth, ID numbers, addresses, and more.
Identity Verification accepts the fixed set of inputs below in order to result in successful Data Source and Documentary Verification checks.
